title: Derived truncation data and the canonical comparison for Picard rank matching
statement: Let f:X→S be proper, flat and locally of finite presentation, E finite locally free, g:T→S, and R(f,E,g) [def-sc-picard-universal-rank-match]. Let F=E or F=E∨, p=pr2:X×_S T→T, q=pr1, and M=p_*q^*F, using [def-pc-module-pullback] and [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. There exist K∈D(O_T) [def-pc-derived-category] and a:M[0]→K such that K is perfect [def-pc-perfect-complex]; H^i(Lk^*K)=0 for all k:Y→T and i<0; every s∈T admits U and r with H^0(L(k≫U.ι)^*K) finite locally free of rank r for every k:Y→U; and H^0(a) is invertible. For every k:Y→T put H=H^0, p′=pr2:(X×_S T)×_T Y→Y, v=pr1, and β:k^*M→p′_*v^*q^*F the specified ordinary map [lem-weil-pbc-module-base-change-map-open-restriction]. There are isomorphisms e0:k^*M≅H(Lk^*(M[0])) and e1:H(Lk^*K)≅p′_*v^*q^*F such that β≫e1.inv=e0.hom≫H(Lk^*a). No surjectivity or invertibility of β or H(Lk^*a) is asserted.

proof.text: Take K=Rp_*(q^*F[0]). Pullbacks and duals preserve finite local freeness. Proper flat finite presentation gives relative flatness of q^*F. Perfect direct image and arbitrary derived base change identify Lk*K with the derived direct image after the iterated base change. Nonnegative injective resolutions give negative vanishing.

Apply R to the identity at s to obtain U,r. On nonempty fibres, pulling the rank-r module E to a common residue-field extension forces each further R-test rank to equal r. The nonempty-fibre locus is open by flat finite presentation and closed by properness. On its complement all direct images vanish, and take r=0. Shrink U into the relevant locus and use locality of finite local freeness. Derived base change and associativity convert these ordinary rank tests into the displayed H0 tests. This step does not use any canonical H0 comparison isomorphism after pullback.

The identity test makes M finite locally free. Connective truncation of K and the degree-zero direct-image identification give a:M[0]→K with invertible H0(a). Flatness of M gives e0 by termwise derived pullback; arbitrary canonical derived base change gives e1.

Use the canonical degree-zero mate square, transporting abstract pullback to tensorPullback with its pinned adjunction. The transpose is pushforward of the pullback unit followed by composition, square commutation and inverse composition. It is the exact moduleBaseChangeMap. Natural truncation and pullback associativity give beta≫e1.inv=e0.hom≫H0(Lk*a), and naturality glues the equality on opens. No matrix-zero conclusion is used.

theorem picardRankMatch_derived_truncation_data
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X S T : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [Flat f] [IsProper f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    [∀ U : T.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings T.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (E : X.Modules) [E.IsFiniteLocallyFree] (g : T ⟶ S)
    (hR : PicardUniversalRankMatch f E g)
    (F : X.Modules) (hF : F = E ∨ F = Modules.dual E) :
    let M := (Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd f g)).obj
      ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj F)
    ∃ (K : schemeDerivedCategory T)
      (a : (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj M ⟶ K),
      IsPerfect T K ∧
      (∀ (Y : Scheme.{u}) (k : Y ⟶ T) (i : ℤ), i < 0 →
        IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) i).obj
            ((derivedPullback k).obj K))) ∧
      (∀ s : T, ∃ U : T.Opens, s ∈ U ∧ ∃ r : ℕ,
        ∀ (Y : Scheme.{u}) (k : Y ⟶ U.toScheme),
          SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u}
            ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
              (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
                ((derivedPullback (k ≫ U.ι)).obj K)) r) ∧
      IsIso ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toRingedSpace)) 0).map a) ∧
      ∀ (Y : Scheme.{u}) (k : Y ⟶ T),
        let H := DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) 0
        ∃ (e0 : (Modules.tensorPullback k).obj M ≅
            H.obj ((derivedPullback k).obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
              (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj M)))
          (e1 : H.obj ((derivedPullback k).obj K) ≅
            (Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd (pullback.snd f g) k)).obj
              ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst (pullback.snd f g) k)).obj
                ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj F))),
          Modules.moduleBaseChangeMap (pullback.snd f g)
              (pullback.snd (pullback.snd f g) k) k
              (pullback.fst (pullback.snd f g) k) pullback.condition
              ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj F) ≫ e1.inv =
            e0.hom ≫ H.map ((derivedPullback k).map a)
